Reporting to the Deputy Fire Chief, Communications, Technology and Organizational Performance, the Division Chief (Data Analytics and Decision Support) provides strategic leadership and oversight of data analytics, business intelligence, organizational performance, information management and decision-support services for Toronto Fire Services.

The position leads multidisciplinary teams in delivering reliable, timely and actionable information to support evidence-based decision-making, operational planning, continuous improvement, public information, accreditation and organizational accountability.

Working collaboratively with senior leadership, operational divisions and external stakeholders, the Division Chief establishes data and information management strategies, governance frameworks and reporting priorities, ensuring compliance with applicable legislation, corporate policies and professional standards.

Major Responsibilities:

Provides strategic leadership and direction for data analytics, business intelligence, performance measurement, information management and decision-support services, including the development of strategies, governance frameworks, standards and priorities.
Leads and develops multidisciplinary teams, fostering an inclusive, accountable and high-performing environment focused on service excellence and continuous improvement.
Oversees analytical studies, dashboards, reporting platforms, data models, statistical tools and geographic information systems, providing strategic advice and recommendations to support operational planning, resource allocation, risk management and policy development.
Establishes performance measures and monitoring frameworks, supporting organizational performance analysis, strategic planning, accreditation, service reviews and continuous improvement initiatives, including Community Risk Assessments, Standards of Cover and annual program appraisals.
Provides oversight of data quality, information governance, records management, privacy, access, disclosure, retention and information stewardship, ensuring compliance with legislative and corporate requirements.
Manages operating and capital budgets, procurement, contracts, consultants and complex projects, ensuring effective governance, risk management and delivery.
Builds and maintains partnerships with City divisions, emergency service agencies, government, academia, vendors and other stakeholders, while monitoring emerging technologies and practices in analytics, artificial intelligence, GIS and public safety information management.

Key Qualifications:

Post-secondary degree or diploma in Data Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Information Systems, Business Administration, Public Administration, Geography, Geomatics or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Extensive experience providing strategic leadership in data analytics, business intelligence, performance measurement, information management or decision-support services within a large, complex organization.
Extensive experience leading and managing multidisciplinary teams, including establishing priorities, overseeing performance, supporting staff development and driving organizational improvement.
Considerable experience applying business intelligence, statistical analysis, data management and geographic information systems to develop analytical studies, dashboards, reporting solutions and recommendations for senior leadership and external partners.
Considerable experience developing and implementing performance measurement frameworks, analytical reporting and data governance practices to support service planning, operational performance, data quality and evidence-based decision-making.
Considerable experience developing and implementing records and information management strategies, governance frameworks and digital information management solutions, including records retention, information lifecycle management and compliance requirements.
Considerable experience managing operating and capital budgets, procurement, contracts, consultants and complex projects.
Expert knowledge of information governance, privacy, access to information, records management and applicable legislation, including MFIPPA, PHIPA and the Archives and Recordkeeping Act, 2006.
Expert knowledge of analytical and reporting technologies such as Power BI, SQL, SQL Server Reporting Services, data warehouses, statistical software, data integration tools and ESRI ArcGIS.
Knowledge of quality management, accreditation and continuous improvement processes, including familiarity with Commission on Fire Accreditation International standards.
Familiarity with municipal government, emergency services, public safety operations or similarly complex operational environments.
Strong strategic thinking, analytical, research and problem-solving skills, with the ability to assess complex issues and provide practical recommendations.
Excellent communication, consultation, negotiation and stakeholder engagement skills, including the ability to present complex technical information to diverse audiences.
Demonstrated political acuity, sound judgment and discretion in managing sensitive or confidential matters, competing priorities and organizational change.
Ability to exercise independent judgment, initiative and accountability while fostering collaborative, inclusive and high-performing teams.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office and related business applications.
Professional certification in data analytics, business intelligence, agile and/or project management, quality management or a related discipline would be considered an asset.

Who We Are Is What We Do.

Deel is the all-in-one payroll and HR platform for global teams. Our vision is to unlock global opportunity for every person, team, and business. Built for the way the world works today, Deel combines HRIS, payroll, compliance, benefits, performance, and equipment management into one seamless platform. With AI-powered tools and a fully owned payroll infrastructure, Deel supports every worker type in 150+ countries—helping businesses scale smarter, faster, and more compliantly.

Among the largest globally distributed companies in the world, our team of 7,000 spans more than 100 countries, speaks 74 languages, and brings a connected and dynamic culture that drives continuous learning and innovation for our customers.

Why should you be part of our success story?

As the fastest-growing Software as a Service (SaaS) company in history, Deel is transforming how global talent connects with world-class companies – breaking down borders that have traditionally limited both hiring and career opportunities. We're not just building software; we're creating the infrastructure for the future of work, enabling a more diverse and inclusive global economy. In 2024 alone, we paid $11.2 billion to workers in nearly 100 currencies and provided healthcare and benefits to workers in 109 countries—ensuring people get paid and protected, no matter where they are.

Our momentum is reflected in our achievements and customer satisfaction: CNBC Disruptor 50, Forbes Cloud 100, Deloitte Fast 500, and repeated recognition on Y Combinator's top companies list – all while maintaining a 4.83 average rating from 15,000 reviews across G2, Trustpilot, Captera, Apple and Google.

Your experience at Deel will be a career accelerator. At the forefront of the global work revolution, you'll tackle complex challenges that impact millions of people's working lives. With our momentum—backed by a $17.3 billion valuation and $1 B in Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) in just over five years—you'll drive meaningful impact while building expertise that makes you a sought-after leader in the transformation of global work.

About The Studio

Deel is one of the fastest-growing companies in the world, and we're building the brand and creative studio to match. We make global campaigns, partnerships, film, design, and social at real scale, for businesses and for workers in almost every country there is.

We're looking for someone exceptional to raise the bar on what we make. This is a hands-on role. You'd set the standard by making the work.

The role

Deel is a truly global, people-first brand, and it's taking off. We're looking for a creative director who works at the front edge of AI-native production across video and design. Most AI creative work is technically impressive and creatively empty. Some of it is good work that used AI somewhere in the pipeline. We think there's a real discipline in between, and we want you to build it here. You'd define how we make this work, and you'd prove it by making it. This is a hands-on role.

What You'll Make

AI-native creative. Work where generative tools are central to how it's made, at a standard the category hasn't reached.
The stack. Our AI creative tooling and the workflows around it, including the principles for where we don't use it.
Video and motion. Brand films, campaign work, and product storytelling that blend traditional and AI-led production.
A repeatable method. Something the rest of the team can use, so the capability outlives any one project.

What You Bring

At least ten years across video, motion, or design, with direction as well as production.
Recent work made or directed with generative AI that stands up as creative work first.
Deep knowledge of the current tooling, and clear judgment about where it breaks.
Proven ability to build a workflow other people can actually use.
A point of view on likeness, disclosure, and provenance. We take these seriously.

What Would Set You Apart

A reel with range across live-action, motion, and generative work.
Experience establishing an AI practice inside a creative team.
A public point of view on AI in creative work.

Who You'll Work With

You'll sit inside the creative studio and work alongside our Creative Director, the video and motion teams, and the brand designers who'll build on what you establish.

How We Work

We're a studio, not a request queue. People here make things rather than manage from a distance. We use AI seriously, and we're deliberate about where we don't.

The role owns budgeting, forecasting, long-range planning, management reporting, and performance analysis; provides financial leadership on revenue, pricing, profitability, customer programs, and strategic initiatives; and develops a high-performing finance team.

This leader serves as a trusted business partner across the organization, strengthens governance and decision support, and drives continuous improvement in financial processes, reporting, and analytics.

Develop integrated financial models, scenarios, dashboards, and management reporting that improve visibility and decision-making.
Partner with senior leadership to evaluate strategic priorities, investments, business cases, and resource allocation decisions.

Lead, coach, and develop the FP&A team; set priorities, clarify accountabilities, and build strong business-partnering capabilities.

Commercial Finance & Controlling

Experience evaluating pricing, customer programs, profitability, and commercial agreements in a complex business environment.
Advanced financial modelling and analytical capability, with strong Excel skills and experience using enterprise planning, ERP, and data-visualization tools.
Strong people leadership, with a track record of setting priorities, developing talent, and building a high-performing team.
Commercial and strategic judgement, with the ability to connect financial outcomes to business drivers and recommend clear actions.
Strong governance mindset, with attention to accuracy, controls, documentation, and accountability.

Brief Description

Qui est Manmade?

Nous sommes un détaillant en ligne de produits essentiels de première qualité basé à Montréal, connu particulièrement jusqu'à présent pour nos boxer pour hommes. Nous avons connu une croissance rapide depuis notre lancement en 2021, et la marque est véritablement à un tournant pour devenir un nom familier au Canada, et elle se développe déjà en parallèle sur le marché américain.

Qui recherchons-nous?

Nous recherchons un(e) Chef(fe) de l’analytique marketing
pour bâtir et diriger la fonction d’analytique marketing de Manmade.

Vous serez responsable de la façon dont nous mesurons et interprétons la performance marketing, en regroupant les données de nos différents canaux pour offrir une vision claire et fiable des facteurs qui contribuent aux résultats de l’entreprise. Une priorité sera de créer une source de référence unique et centralisée
pour la performance marketing et de mettre en place les tableaux de bord, les indicateurs clés de performance et les cadres de mesure qui guideront les décisions de nos équipes.

Il s’agit d’un poste de niveau senior avec une forte implication opérationnelle
. Vous devrez explorer les données, créer des tableaux de bord, analyser la performance et résoudre vous-même les problèmes, tout en établissant les bases d’une équipe et d’une fonction capables d’évoluer avec Manmade.

Si vous aimez transformer des données complexes en décisions d’affaires claires et souhaitez bâtir une fonction à partir de zéro, nous aimerions vous rencontrer.

Ce poste est-il fait pour vous ?

Nous nous développons rapidement, les choses changent vite et une présence en interne est nécessaire.

Ce que nous offrons?
Nous pensons qu'un travail de qualité commence par un environnement de qualité. En tant que membre de notre équipe, vous bénéficierez de déjeuners quotidiens gratuits, de collations et de boissons pour vous permettre de rester en forme et concentré. Nous sommes dans une phase de croissance, ce qui signifie de réelles opportunités pour vous d'apprendre, de vous développer et de faire passer votre carrière au niveau supérieur. Responsabilités

Bâtir et prendre en charge la fonction d’analytique et de mesure marketing de Manmade, tant pour l’acquisition que pour la fidélisation de la clientèle.
Créer une source de référence unique pour la performance marketing en regroupant les données de Meta, Google, TikTok, du marketing par courriel, du marketing d’influence, de Shopify et de l’analytique Web.
Concevoir et maintenir des tableaux de bord, des cadres d’indicateurs clés de performance et des rapports offrant aux équipes Marketing et à la direction une vision claire de la performance.

Mener des analyses approfondies pour répondre à des questions d’affaires complexes et repérer des occasions d’amélioration en matière d’acquisition, de fidélisation et de valeur vie client.

De 7 à 10 ans d’expérience progressive en analytique marketing, en analytique de croissance, en intelligence d’affaires, en analyse de données ou dans un domaine connexe.
Solide expérience en commerce électronique, en vente directe aux consommateurs (DTC), dans le secteur des produits de consommation ou au sein d’une autre entreprise numérique à forte croissance.
Expérience démontrée dans la création ou le développement d’une fonction d’analytique marketing, notamment les tableaux de bord, les cadres d’indicateurs clés de performance, les rapports et les processus de mesure.
Maîtrise avancée de SQL et d’Excel, ainsi qu’une solide expérience avec des outils d’intelligence d’affaires comme Looker, Tableau, Power BI ou des outils similaires.
Expérience avec Shopify, GA4, Meta, Google, TikTok et d’autres plateformes de marketing numérique.
Compréhension approfondie du CAC, de la LTV, du ROAS, du MER, de la rétention, de la conversion, de l’analyse de cohortes, de l’attribution et de la rentabilité par client.

Solide sens des affaires et capacité à relier la performance marketing aux résultats commerciaux et financiers de l’entreprise.
Capacité à définir la stratégie analytique tout en explorant personnellement les données et en développant des solutions.
Excellentes aptitudes en communication et capacité à traduire des données complexes en constats clairs pour les équipes Marketing, Finance et la direction.

Baccalauréat dans un domaine pertinent ou expérience professionnelle équivalente.

Responsibilities

Build scalable analytics processes, tools, and infrastructure, and establish the roadmap for the function as Manmade grows.
Remain deeply hands-on while eventually building and leading a high-performing marketing analytics team.

Qualifications

7–10 years of progressive experience in marketing analytics, growth analytics, business intelligence, data analytics, or a related field.

The Assistant Vice President, Information Security is First National’s enterprise cybersecurity leader within Product and Technology. The role sets cybersecurity direction, operates the Information Security function, improves cyber resilience, and enables secure delivery across applications, infrastructure, cloud, identity, data, integrations, and AI.

The AVP combines technical credibility with executive leadership, sound risk judgment, and disciplined execution. The role initially reports to the Chief Product and Technology Officer and is expected to transition to the Vice President, Technology Governance, Risk and Performance as the target operating model is established, while retaining direct escalation access to the CPTO for material cyber incidents or risk exposures.

How You Will Contribute

Cybersecurity Strategy, Governance and Assurance

Define and execute the cybersecurity strategy and capability roadmap aligned to business priorities, technology modernization, risk appetite, client obligations, and the Product and Technology operating model.
Serve as the senior cybersecurity authority within Product and Technology, advising executives and governance forums on material risk, incidents, exceptions, investment priorities, and security performance. Operate first line cyber risk management while accountable business and technology owners remain responsible for remediation and residual risk decisions within delegated authority.
Maintain and continuously improve the Information Security Management System, policies, standards, control requirements, cybersecurity compliance activities, and performance measures. Maintain strong ISO 27001 aligned practices and support applicable regulatory, contractual, client, and internal policy requirements.
Lead the Information Security responsibilities for SOC 1 and SOC 2 audits and attestations, including security control ownership, evidence readiness, management responses, remediation, and external auditor support, in partnership with Technology Governance, Risk and Performance.
Own the security response to client questionnaires, due diligence, audits, assurance reviews, and control assessments from third party underwriting and servicing clients and strategic partners. Act as the senior security contact for client security teams and maintain reusable approved responses, control narratives, and evidence to improve speed and consistency.

Security Operations, Incident Response & Cyber Resilience

Lead security monitoring, managed detection and response, threat intelligence, detection engineering, incident response, and digital forensics coordination, with clear service levels and performance expectations for managed security providers.
Lead the technical cyber response during material incidents and coordinate with technology, business, legal, privacy, communications, risk, and other enterprise leaders on crisis management, notification, service recovery, and business continuity actions.
Maintain and test cyber incident playbooks, executive and technical exercises, and recovery scenarios, using incidents, threat intelligence, control testing, and exercises to drive continuous improvement and tracked corrective actions.

Security Engineering, Identity, Cloud and Application Security

Define practical security architecture standards, reusable patterns, Zero Trust principles, and minimum control requirements across cloud, infrastructure, networks, end user computing, applications, APIs, integrations, data platforms, and emerging technology.
Set identity security requirements across authentication, privileged access, access governance, conditional access, service identities, secrets, certificates, and excessive or persistent access, while partnering with Enterprise IT and Infrastructure on endpoint, network, cloud, logging, backup, and hardening controls.
Embed security into engineering practices and delivery pipelines through secure coding, threat modelling, dependency and secrets scanning, SAST, DAST, penetration testing, API security, software supply chain controls, and proportionate automated security gates.
Own the vulnerability and exposure management program, including discovery, risk prioritization, remediation standards, exception governance, validation, aging visibility, and escalation. Engineering, Infrastructure, and service owners remain accountable for remediation.
Prioritize material security debt in legacy and proprietary applications and use penetration testing, attack simulation, red team, or purple team techniques where they provide clear risk reduction or validate material controls.

AI, Data, Third Party and Human Risk

Define cybersecurity guardrails for AI and automation, including identity, sensitive data handling, secrets, model and prompt attack risks, third party AI services, logging, monitoring, abuse protection, and secure integration patterns, while partnering with Product, Engineering, Data, Privacy, Legal, and Risk on broader governance.
Set technical data protection requirements for access, leakage prevention, monitoring, and protection of sensitive customer and business information while data governance and privacy accountabilities remain with their respective owners.
Own the cybersecurity assessment, security requirements, risk recommendations, and monitoring components of critical third party and cloud service risk, while Procurement, vendor management, business owners, and Enterprise Risk retain their broader lifecycle accountabilities.
Lead an effective security awareness and human risk program using role based education and targeted interventions for higher risk populations and activities.

Leadership and Operating Performance

Build and lead a high performing Information Security team with clear accountabilities, modern technical depth, succession coverage, and a culture of ownership, transparency, and collaboration.
Define the security operating model, workforce plan, capability roadmap, and sourcing approach across internal capability, managed services, and specialist expertise.
Manage the security budget, tools, vendors, and service performance with clear linkage between spend, risk reduction, control effectiveness, remediation performance, incident response, and continuous improvement, rationalizing overlap where it adds cost or complexity without improving protection.

The Experience You Need

Leadership and Industry Experience

Significant progressive experience in cybersecurity, information security, security engineering, or technology risk, typically including 12 or more years of relevant experience and several years leading multidisciplinary security teams or major enterprise security programs.
Demonstrated experience advising senior executives and making risk based decisions during material cyber incidents, significant technology changes, or major control issues.
Experience leading security through modernization, cloud adoption, managed service models, operating model change, or significant technology transformation. Experience in financial services, lending, payments, insurance, or another regulated and data intensive environment is strongly preferred.

Technical, Assurance and Regulatory Depth

Strong practical knowledge of security operations, incident response, vulnerability management, identity and privileged access, cloud security, application and API security, DevSecOps, data protection, third party security, security architecture, cyber resilience, and software supply chain security.
Strong experience with Microsoft Azure and Microsoft 365 security capabilities, with working familiarity across Microsoft Sentinel, Defender, Entra ID, Conditional Access, Purview, Intune, and GRC platforms used for cyber risk, controls, issues, evidence, audit, and assurance workflows.
Strong working knowledge of ISO 27001, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, SOC control environments, Zero Trust principles, PIPEDA, applicable provincial privacy requirements, FSRA expectations where relevant, and client driven cyber expectations from regulated financial institutions, including relevant OSFI guidance where applicable through client or contractual obligations.
Practical understanding of AI security risks and controls and the ability to challenge technical designs and remediation plans credibly without needing to personally perform every engineering task.

Education, Communication and Judgment

Professional certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CRISC, CISA, CCSP, or comparable credentials are preferred.
Exceptional written and verbal communication, executive presence, sound judgment under pressure, and the ability to translate technical and regulatory risk into clear decisions, priorities, and accountabilities.

Professional fluency in English is required; French is an asset.

Relationships

new_jobs.title: Directeur(trice) de l’analytique marketing / Director of Marketing Analytics
new_jobs.description:
Brief Description

Qui est Manmade?

Nous sommes un détaillant en ligne de produits essentiels de première qualité basé à Montréal, connu particulièrement jusqu'à présent pour nos boxer pour hommes. Nous avons connu une croissance rapide depuis notre lancement en 2021, et la marque est véritablement à un tournant pour devenir un nom familier au Canada, et elle se développe déjà en parallèle sur le marché américain.

Qui recherchons-nous?

Nous recherchons un(e) Chef(fe) de l’analytique marketing
pour bâtir et diriger la fonction d’analytique marketing de Manmade.

Vous serez responsable de la façon dont nous mesurons et interprétons la performance marketing, en regroupant les données de nos différents canaux pour offrir une vision claire et fiable des facteurs qui contribuent aux résultats de l’entreprise. Une priorité sera de créer une source de référence unique et centralisée
pour la performance marketing et de mettre en place les tableaux de bord, les indicateurs clés de performance et les cadres de mesure qui guideront les décisions de nos équipes.

Il s’agit d’un poste de niveau senior avec une forte implication opérationnelle
. Vous devrez explorer les données, créer des tableaux de bord, analyser la performance et résoudre vous-même les problèmes, tout en établissant les bases d’une équipe et d’une fonction capables d’évoluer avec Manmade.

Si vous aimez transformer des données complexes en décisions d’affaires claires et souhaitez bâtir une fonction à partir de zéro, nous aimerions vous rencontrer.

Ce poste est-il fait pour vous ?

Nous nous développons rapidement, les choses changent vite et une présence en interne est nécessaire.

Ce que nous offrons?
Nous pensons qu'un travail de qualité commence par un environnement de qualité. En tant que membre de notre équipe, vous bénéficierez de déjeuners quotidiens gratuits, de collations et de boissons pour vous permettre de rester en forme et concentré. Nous offrons une assurance de groupe payée à 100 %, des salaires compétitifs qui sont révisés régulièrement avec des augmentations annuelles garanties, et une structure de primes de partage des bénéfices pour que tout le monde participe à notre succès.

Nous sommes dans une phase de croissance, ce qui signifie de réelles opportunités pour vous d'apprendre, de vous développer et de faire passer votre carrière au niveau supérieur. Avant tout, vous ferez partie d'une culture amusante, innovante et respectueuse où vos idées sont valorisées et où votre impact est réel.

Responsabilités

Bâtir et prendre en charge la fonction d’analytique et de mesure marketing de Manmade, tant pour l’acquisition que pour la fidélisation de la clientèle.
Créer une source de référence unique pour la performance marketing en regroupant les données de Meta, Google, TikTok, du marketing par courriel, du marketing d’influence, de Shopify et de l’analytique Web.
Concevoir et maintenir des tableaux de bord, des cadres d’indicateurs clés de performance et des rapports offrant aux équipes Marketing et à la direction une vision claire de la performance.
Analyser les indicateurs clés, notamment le coût d’acquisition client (CAC), la valeur vie client (LTV), le rendement des dépenses publicitaires (ROAS), le ratio d’efficacité marketing (MER), la rétention, la conversion, les cohortes de clients et la performance des canaux.
Collaborer avec les équipes Marketing et Finance pour relier les investissements et la performance marketing aux revenus, à la rentabilité par client et à une croissance rentable.
Évaluer la performance des canaux, des campagnes, des audiences et des créations publicitaires, puis traduire les résultats en recommandations claires et concrètes.
Développer l’approche de Manmade en matière d’attribution, d’incrémentalité, d’expérimentation et de mesure marketing, notamment au moyen de tests A/B, de tests géographiques et de groupes témoins.
Consolider et valider les données provenant des différentes plateformes afin de garantir l’exactitude et la fiabilité des rapports.
Mener des analyses approfondies pour répondre à des questions d’affaires complexes et repérer des occasions d’amélioration en matière d’acquisition, de fidélisation et de valeur vie client.
Mettre en place des processus, des outils et une infrastructure analytiques capables de soutenir la croissance, et définir la feuille de route de la fonction.
Maintenir une forte implication opérationnelle tout en bâtissant et en dirigeant, à terme, une équipe d’analytique marketing performante.

Éxigences

De 7 à 10 ans d’expérience progressive en analytique marketing, en analytique de croissance, en intelligence d’affaires, en analyse de données ou dans un domaine connexe.
Solide expérience en commerce électronique, en vente directe aux consommateurs (DTC), dans le secteur des produits de consommation ou au sein d’une autre entreprise numérique à forte croissance.
Expérience démontrée dans la création ou le développement d’une fonction d’analytique marketing, notamment les tableaux de bord, les cadres d’indicateurs clés de performance, les rapports et les processus de mesure.
Maîtrise avancée de SQL et d’Excel, ainsi qu’une solide expérience avec des outils d’intelligence d’affaires comme Looker, Tableau, Power BI ou des outils similaires.
Expérience avec Shopify, GA4, Meta, Google, TikTok et d’autres plateformes de marketing numérique.
Compréhension approfondie du CAC, de la LTV, du ROAS, du MER, de la rétention, de la conversion, de l’analyse de cohortes, de l’attribution et de la rentabilité par client.
Expérience en expérimentation marketing et en mesure de l’incrémentalité, notamment les tests A/B, les tests géographiques et les groupes témoins.
Solide sens des affaires et capacité à relier la performance marketing aux résultats commerciaux et financiers de l’entreprise.
Capacité à définir la stratégie analytique tout en explorant personnellement les données et en développant des solutions.
Excellentes aptitudes en communication et capacité à traduire des données complexes en constats clairs pour les équipes Marketing, Finance et la direction.
Une expérience dans la constitution d’équipes, le mentorat ou la gestion de professionnels en analytique est fortement souhaitée.
Baccalauréat dans un domaine pertinent ou expérience professionnelle équivalente.

Who is Manmade?

We’re a Montreal-based online retailer of premium quality essentials, known particularly so far for our men’s boxer briefs. We have been rapidly growing since launching in 2021, and the brand is truly at a turning point to becoming a household name in Canada, and already growing rapidly in parallel in the US market.

Who is Manmade looking for?

We’re looking for a Head of Marketing Analytics
to build and lead Manmade’s marketing analytics function.

You’ll own how we measure and understand marketing performance, bringing together data across our channels to create a clear, trusted view of what’s driving the business. A key priority will be building a unified source of truth
for marketing performance and establishing the dashboards, KPIs, and measurement frameworks our teams use to make decisions.

This is a senior but deeply hands-on role
. You’ll be expected to dig into the data, build dashboards, analyze performance, and solve problems yourself while creating the foundation for a team and function that can scale with Manmade.

If you love turning complex data into clear business decisions and want the opportunity to build something from the ground up, we’d love to hear from you.

Is this for you?

We are growing so rapidly so things are changing so quickly and an in-house presence is required

What are we offering?
Aside from a competitive compensation package, the opportunity in itself is what you make of it. With the company growing 250%+ year over year for the past 3 years, and with expected growth to continue at a high pace for the next 2-3 years, there will be many different ways to grow within the company as it enters new markets, channels, and so on.

We offer extended health and dental benefits, 100% fully paid by the employer. We offer catered lunches every day and all the snacks, drinks, coffee, and fruit you could want.

Responsibilities

Own and build Manmade’s marketing analytics and measurement function across customer acquisition and retention.
Create a unified source of truth for marketing performance across Meta, Google, TikTok, Email, Influencer, Shopify, and web analytics.
Build and maintain dashboards, KPI frameworks, and reporting that give Marketing and leadership a clear view of performance.
Analyze key metrics including CAC, LTV, ROAS, MER, retention, conversion, customer cohorts, and channel performance.
Partner with Marketing and Finance to connect marketing investment and performance to revenue, customer economics, and profitable growth.
Evaluate channel, campaign, audience, and creative performance and turn findings into clear, actionable recommendations.
Develop Manmade’s approach to attribution, incrementality, experimentation, and marketing measurement, including A/B tests, geo studies, and holdouts.
Consolidate and validate data across platforms, ensuring reporting is accurate, reliable, and trusted.
Conduct deep-dive analyses to answer complex business questions and identify opportunities across acquisition, retention, and customer lifetime value.
Build scalable analytics processes, tools, and infrastructure, and establish the roadmap for the function as Manmade grows.
Remain deeply hands-on while eventually building and leading a high-performing marketing analytics team.

Qualifications

7–10 years of progressive experience in marketing analytics, growth analytics, business intelligence, data analytics, or a related field.
Strong experience in e-commerce, DTC, consumer, or another high-growth digital business.
Proven experience building or scaling a marketing analytics function, including dashboards, KPI frameworks, reporting, and measurement processes.
Advanced proficiency in SQL and Excel, with strong experience in BI tools such as Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or similar.
Experience with Shopify, GA4, Meta, Google, TikTok, and other digital marketing platforms.
Deep understanding of CAC, LTV, ROAS, MER, retention, conversion, cohort analysis, attribution, and customer economics.
Experience with marketing experimentation and incrementality, including A/B testing, geo testing, and holdouts.
Strong commercial acumen with the ability to connect marketing performance to broader business and financial outcomes.
Ability to operate at both levels: setting analytics strategy while personally digging into the data and building solutions.
Strong communication skills with the ability to translate complex data into clear insights for Marketing, Finance, and leadership.
Experience building, mentoring, or leading analytics talent is strongly preferred.
Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field or equivalent professional experience.

new_jobs.description:
Job Description

The Director, Equipment Planning and Biomedical Services is accountable for clinical and non-clinical asset planning, maintenance and management. The role provides overall leadership to Mackenzie Health equipment needs for short-term and long-term asset planning, tracking, maintenance, management, and refresh. The director is responsible for overseeing all facility and redevelopment work required to plan, procure, and complete installation of medical equipment. This role also provides Director-level leadership to the Central Equipment and Biomedical Engineering departments. This role works within an environment that has Design-Build-Finance-Maintain (DBFP) equipment relationships, Managed Equipment Services (MES) contract, as well as a traditional in-house biomedical engineering service and support model. This role also works closely with Mackenzie Health Redevelopment department to plan, procure, and implement the Furniture, Fixtures, and Equipment (FF&E) components of various redevelopment projects. Additionally, the Director coordinates efforts with various departments to develop and maintain a multi-year equipment plan and budget, ensuring appropriate inventory levels, mitigation of corporate risk, and balances demand with broader organizational need.

Primary Responsibilities

Maintain current knowledge of laws, ordinances, and regulations pertaining to corporate purchasing practices.
Working in close collaboration with corporate procurement, develop a multi year clinical technology strategy, in conjunction with clinical and nonclinical leaders, and that aligns with organizational priorities. The strategy must include centralized purchasing/procurement of materials, equipment, machinery, and services required for operations, projects, and capital investments.
Responsible for the implementation of all Equipment projects from needs identification through to commissioning and on-going maintenance.
Manage and oversee all aspects of large-scale equipment installation projects including managing internal and external stakeholders, shop drawing reviews, scope of work development, project schedule development, budget management, reporting, commissioning, training, and close-out documentation.
Work collaboratively with the Digital Health portfolio to ensure all required integrations are planned and implemented to support equipment use.
Provide executive leadership with strategic and tactical advice, as well as risks and opportunities related to emerging healthcare technologies and long-term organizational planning.
Provide advice to management at all levels by using knowledge of equipment market and procurement.
Working in close collaboration with corporate procurement, supervise or manage complex negotiations to settle commercial disputes and claims with suppliers by establishing goals and approving commercial settlements.
Manage the Philips MESP contract ($300M+ over 14-year contract life) and provide support to Philips and the Mackenzie Clinical team in the administration of the MESP contracted services.
Provide direct leadership to Biomedical Engineering and Central Equipment staff and services across a multi site hospital system.
Establish policies and procedures supporting safe equipment use and maintenance.
Lead service contract procurement and negotiations.
Monitor vendor performance and service level agreements.
Develop performance KPI for adequate service and support of medical equipment.
Work with multiple equipment vendors to coordinate design and construction activities, monitor performance and intervene to rectify issues.
Ensure the development and maintenance of work systems, goals and objectives, management systems, teamwork, and resource management for departments within the area of accountability.
Create and maintain asset management and tracking workflows and processes.
Create and maintain a space management program.
Space management includes oversight and recommendations to resolve all space requests. Working collaboratively with Redevelopment, Facilities, Clinical, Clinical Support Teams to ensure space allocations are prioritized and allocated based on hospital priorities.
Act as Chair of the Change Request Group (SAFES) to ensure alignment with corporate vision and mission.
Manage the intake, review, and implementation of all changes related to Space, Aesthetics, Furniture, Equipment, and Signage.
Provide leadership, support, and direction to program staff on issues related to performance, corporate direction, service delivery, staff development, Human Resources Management (HRM), realignment, and change management strategies.
Direct the process of establishing, implementing, and reporting on appropriate quality and productivity indicator measurement tools, based on provincial benchmarks, best practice standards, and legislative requirements.
Co-develop annual budgets and operating plans that align with the hospital’s programs and directives, and ensure the program stays within budget.
Ensure all assigned employees comply with hospital, government, and customer policies, procedures, and regulations.
Build external and internal business relationships to gather information, identify market and industry trends, build partnership and alliances to support and facilitate the hospital’s objectives and plans.
Management of Regulatory Requirements as applicable to equipment installations ensuring all documentation is submitted and approved by appropriate regulatory bodies to support the installation and use of medical equipment (e.g. HARP, CNSC).
Ensure effective procurement activities that meet the requirements and needs of the hospital’s internal stakeholders.
Ensure a safe environment for patients, staff, and visitors; investigate, report, debrief and take or direct corrective action as appropriate on incidents.
Manage human resources which include recruitment, selection and training.
Teach, coach and lead staff in the development and monitoring of quality indicators and improvement initiatives.
Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders/organizations/community groups to achieve program objectives, integrate, and link services and foster partnerships across the continuum of service delivery.
Participate in education and training specific to current, relevant federal and provincial health and safety legislation, standards, and guidelines.

What must you have?

Minimum of a Master’s Degree or Master’s ready in Business, Economics, or in a related field, from an accredited university.
Minimum of 5-10 years experience working in equipment planning and procurement within a health care environment.
Minimum of five (5) years’ working in a senior leadership role, preferably in a health care environment.
Biomedical service leadership experience is required or similar experience that is deemed equivalent.
Training or recent experience with drafting requests for proposals and vendor agreements is required.

What else do you bring?

Strong knowledge of hospital operations.
Demonstrated experience in negotiating and managing large, complex contracts.
Demonstrated knowledge of the appropriate tools for grading, analyzing, and assessing materials, equipment, supplies, services, and other commodities.
Demonstrated knowledge of Supply Chain Management (SCM), Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), and Material Requirements Planning (MRP) software.
Demonstrated excellent critical and logical thinking, analysis, and reasoning to identify underlying principles, reasons, or facts.
Demonstrated project management, change management, and analytical thinking skills.
Demonstrated ability to lead, motivate, and influence individuals and teams toward a vision, while maintaining group cohesiveness and effectiveness.
Demonstrated strategic business sense with financial management and budget development skills.
Demonstrated understanding of interrelationships between clinical and support programs.
Demonstrated ability to manage complex systems and human resources at the executive level.
Demonstrated leadership skills with ability to foster relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
Demonstrated ability to coach, advise and teach others using the principles of adult learning.
Demonstrated training, experience, or utilization of lean methodology for process improvement.
Demonstrated ability to independently identify issues, plan improvements, measure success and continue improvement.
Proven attendance record.
Demonstrates understanding and complies with patient and staff safety policies and procedures that foster a safe and inclusive environment for all.
Ability to perform the essential duties of the job.
Effectively uses empathy in interactions with others.
Demonstrates behaviours consistent with Mackenzie Health’s Commitment to Caring.
Models behaviour that is aligned with the values of Mackenzie Health – Excellence, Leadership and Empathy.
Commitment to providing an exceptional experience for staff and clients within a challenging and exciting health care environment.

Preferably, Your Profile Also Includes

Additional specialized training will be considered an asset (e.g. Professional Certification in Supply Chain Logistics (P. Log) or a Designation as a Supply Chain Management Professional (SCMP).
